gloss: to rival; to be comparable to

definitions.gloss: to rival; to match; to be comparable to; to be on par with
definitions.explanation: To be equal or comparable in quality, scale, or ability to something noteworthy. Often used to emphasize that something reaches the level of something impressive.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{匹敵|ひってき}する⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧はいない。
examples.english: No one can match his talent.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{匹敵|ひってき}する⟦{出来|でき}→出来：11763_deki⟧だ。
examples.english: This film is of a quality that rivals the masterpieces.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{匹敵|ひってき}するほどだった。
examples.english: This year's typhoon damage was on par with the worst on record.

notes:
Used to express that something reaches the level of something else that is typically impressive or notable. Takes the pattern A⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧B⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{匹敵|ひってき}する (A rivals B / A is comparable to B). Often appears in written or formal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{匹敵|ひってき}する⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧: power comparable to ~
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{匹敵|ひってき}する⟦{規模|きぼ}→規模：05095_kibo⟧: a scale rivaling ~
- {匹敵|ひってき}するもの⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: unrivaled; without equal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{相当|そうとう}する→相当する：21146_soutousuru⟧: to correspond to — more neutral, used for equivalence without the nuance of impressiveness
- ⟦{肩|かた}を{並|なら}べる→肩を並べる：18128_katawonaraberu⟧: to stand shoulder to shoulder — idiomatic, implies achieving the same level
- ⟦{対抗|たいこう}する→対抗する：17344_taikousuru⟧: to compete against — implies active rivalry or opposition
